author: Texas A&M University
title: New injectable bandages could cut bleeding time by up to 70%
description: "If these materials get into the first aid kits in an ambulance as well as a soldier's backpack, they can save a lot of lives."
content:
Researchers are developing emergency injectable bandages that could decrease bleeding time by as much as 70% and revolutionize the future of trauma care.
